dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (JMA standard receipt software), developed by NaCl for Japan Medical Association. Compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL based on file naming conventions and ORCA project characteristics.
evidence: no EXEC CICS/SQL, no COMP-3, consistent with GnuCOBOL target

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) processing system - specifically inpatient (入院) diagnosis classification point aggregation (診療区分別点数集計)
purpose.summary: This program is part of the JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt software system for Japan. It performs aggregation and editing of medical treatment points by diagnosis category for inpatient receipts (入院レセプト). The program has an extensive revision history spanning 2002-2007 covering various Japanese national health insurance rule changes and regional public expense (地方公費) handling.

notable_features: Extensive Japanese-language comments (EUC-JP encoded, displayed as latin-1 mojibake)
51 COPY statements indicating heavy use of shared copybooks
939 PERFORM statements indicating complex procedural logic
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
No COMP-3 usage (unusual for financial calculations - may use COMP or display numeric)
Long revision history with version numbers from 01.00.01 through 03.05.xx spanning 2002-2007
Handles Japanese regional public expense (地方公費) variations by prefecture
verdict.notes: File is encoded in EUC-JP (Japanese) but decoded as latin-1, causing mojibake in comment text. The program name ORCR0640 follows the ORCA naming convention (ORC prefix). Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of ~958KB total. The absence of COMP-3 is notable for a financial calculation program but consistent with some GnuCOBOL ORCA programs that use COMP or PIC 9 display fields.
